EventSpawnEntry.description: EventSpawnEntry associates an event from db/events.xml with mission-defined positions and optional settings for infected spawned around those positions.

name.description: Name matches the event identifier in db/events.xml.

pos.description:
Pos lists positions where this event may spawn.
A position may reference a reusable object group from cfgeventgroups.xml.

zone.description:
Zone sets infected-count ranges and their spawn radius for positions in this event.
It is used when the event has a secondary infected event.

EventSpawnPos.description: EventSpawnPos stores one mission-defined event position in map coordinates.

a.description:
A is the event's yaw rotation in degrees. Shipped mission data also uses -1,
so retain the supplied value instead of normalizing it.

group.description: Group names a cfgeventgroups.xml group to create at this position.

x.description: X is the map's horizontal X coordinate.

y.description: Y is the optional world height. It may be omitted when placement uses terrain height.

z.description: Z is the map's horizontal Z coordinate.

EventSpawnZone.description: EventSpawnZone controls the number and spread of infected spawned around an event position when the event defines a secondary infected event.

dmax.description: DMax is the upper bound for the dynamic infected count.

dmin.description: DMin is the lower bound for the dynamic infected count.

r.description: R is the radius in meters around the event position where infected may spawn.

smax.description: SMax is the upper bound for the static infected count.

smin.description: SMin is the lower bound for the static infected count.

event.description: Events is list of event spawn definitions.

eventposdef.description: XMLName is XML root marker for `<eventposdef>`.
